title: China’s Most Famous Emperor: Li Shimin
synopsis: Li Shimin’s rise to the throne was not easy.

fullText.simplified:
中国最有名的皇帝—李世民

    如果你要问中国人最怀念中国的哪个朝代？很多中国人会回答：唐朝。
    如果你要问中国人最喜欢唐朝的哪个皇帝？很多中国人会回答：唐太宗李世民。
    唐朝是中国历史上统一时间最长，国力最强盛的朝代之一。而唐朝的强盛，和唐太宗李世民有很大的关系。李世民是中国最有名的皇帝之一。直至今日，依然有很多书籍、电视剧在津津乐道他的传奇人生。
    要说李世民，得先从一场流血的宫廷政变说起。
    李世民的父亲李渊有三个儿子：大儿子李建成、二儿子李世民和三儿子李元吉。李世民一直跟随父亲打仗，帮着父亲推翻了隋朝，建立了唐朝。
    唐朝建立后，李渊当了皇帝。他没有按功劳大小、才干高低来选太子，而是按照惯例封了大儿子李建成做太子。这就引起了李世民和他手下将士们的不满。他们觉得是他们一直跟随李渊东征西讨，打下了这个天下，理应由功劳最大的李世民当太子。而老大李建成也知道李世民功劳最大，所以他很不安，生怕李世民抢走了他的太子之位。于是，他联合老三李元吉一起排挤李世民。双方的矛盾越来越大。
    正在这个时候，北方突厥入侵。以往都是李世民领兵出征，但这一次，李建成和李元吉商量着不能再让李世民领兵出征了。他们想趁此机会建立功劳，夺过李世民的兵权，再把他杀掉。
    不料这个消息被泄露出去了。李世民知道后很气愤。他抢先一步，领人埋伏在皇宫的玄武门边，先下手杀死了李建成和李元吉。
    事成之后，李世民禀告父亲李渊：“建成和元吉想造反，被我杀了。”李渊听后很吃惊，虽然知道事情也许不是这个样子的，但事已至此，而且李世民掌握着兵权，他也不好说什么，只好低头默认，封了李世民做太子。
    没过多久，李世民又逼迫父亲李渊退位。在手下将士们的拥护下，自己做了皇帝，即“唐太宗”，改年号为“贞观”。
    这就是历史上有名的“玄武门之变”。从情理上说，唐太宗李世民亲手杀死了自己的亲兄弟，又逼迫父亲退位，当然是非常不光彩的。但是站在更广阔的角度观察，他的确是一个英明的君主，值得赞扬的好皇帝。
    李世民上台后，颁布了许多减轻老百姓负担的政策法令。因为他亲身经历过隋朝末年的痛苦历史，深知老百姓的重要，所以他时常提醒自己和儿子们：“民，水也；君，舟也。水能载舟，亦能覆舟。”意思是说：皇帝是船，老百姓是水。水能载起船，也能把船打翻。
    正因为唐太宗李世民的爱民亲民、知人善用，他在位期间，国家经济发展、社会安定、政治清明、人民安康，唐朝出现了空前的繁荣。因为其年号为“贞观”，所以人们将其在位期间的清明政治称为“贞观之治”。
fullText.traditional:
中國最有名的皇帝—李世民

    如果你要問中國人最懷念中國的哪個朝代？很多中國人會回答：唐朝。
    如果你要問中國人最喜歡唐朝的哪個皇帝？很多中國人會回答：唐太宗李世民。
    唐朝是中國歷史上統一時間最長，國力最強盛的朝代之一。而唐朝的強盛，和唐太宗李世民有很大的關係。李世民是中國最有名的皇帝之一。直至今日，依然有很多書籍、電視劇在津津樂道他的傳奇人生。
    要說李世民，得先從一場流血的宮廷政變說起。
    李世民的父親李淵有三個兒子：大兒子李建成、二兒子李世民和三兒子李元吉。李世民一直跟隨父親打仗，幫著父親推翻了隋朝，建立了唐朝。
    唐朝建立後，李淵當了皇帝。他沒有按功勞大小、才幹高低來選太子，而是按照慣例封了大兒子李建成做太子。這就引起了李世民和他手下將士們的不滿。他們覺得是他們一直跟隨李淵東征西討，打下了這個天下，理應由功勞最大的李世民當太子。而老大李建成也知道李世民功勞最大，所以他很不安，生怕李世民搶走了他的太子之位。於是，他聯合老三李元吉一起排擠李世民。雙方的矛盾越來越大。
    正在這個時候，北方突厥入侵。以往都是李世民領兵出征，但這一次，李建成和李元吉商量著不能再讓李世民領兵出征了。他們想趁此機會建立功勞，奪過李世民的兵權，再把他殺掉。
    不料這個消息被泄露出去了。李世民知道後很氣憤。他搶先一步，領人埋伏在皇宮的玄武門邊，先下手殺死了李建成和李元吉。
    事成之後，李世民稟告父親李淵：“建成和元吉想造反，被我殺了。”李淵聽後很吃驚，雖然知道事情也許不是這個樣子的，但事已至此，而且李世民掌握著兵權，他也不好說什麼，只好低頭默認，封了李世民做太子。
    沒過多久，李世民又逼迫父親李淵退位。在手下將士們的擁護下，自己做了皇帝，即“唐太宗”，改年號為“貞觀”。
    這就是歷史上有名的“玄武門之變”。從情理上說，唐太宗李世民親手殺死了自己的親兄弟，又逼迫父親退位，當然是非常不光彩的。但是站在更廣闊的角度觀察，他的確是一個英明的君主，值得讚揚的好皇帝。
    李世民上台後，頒布了許多減輕老百姓負擔的政策法令。因為他親身經歷過隋朝末年的痛苦歷史，深知老百姓的重要，所以他時常提醒自己和兒子們：“民，水也；君，舟也。水能載舟，亦能覆舟。”意思是說：皇帝是船，老百姓是水。水能載起船，也能把船打翻。
    正因為唐太宗李世民的愛民親民、知人善用，他在位期間，國家經濟發展、社會安定、政治清明、人民安康，唐朝出現了空前的繁榮。因為其年號為“貞觀”，所以人們將其在位期間的清明政治稱為“貞觀之治”。

sentences.english: .. this was the current situation, and also Li Shimin held military power.
There was nothing to say, and he could only give in and tacitly agree, appointing Li Shimin as crown prince.

sentences.simplified: 没过多久，李世民又逼迫父亲李渊退位。
sentences.traditional: 沒過多久，李世民又逼迫父親李淵退位。
sentences.pinyin: méi guò duō jiǔ lǐ shì mín yòu bī pò fù qīn lǐ yuān tuì wèi

sentences.simplified: 在手下将士们的拥护下，自己做了皇帝，即“唐太宗”，
sentences.traditional: 在手下將士們的擁護下，自己做了皇帝，即“唐太宗”，
sentences.pinyin: zài shǒu xià jiàng shì men de yōng hù xià zì jǐ zuò le huáng dì jí táng tài zōng
sentences.english: Before long, Li Shimin also forced his father Li Yuan to abdicate.

sentences.simplified: 改年号为“贞观”。
sentences.traditional: 改年號為“貞觀”。
sentences.pinyin: gǎi nián hào wèi zhēn guàn
sentences.english: With the support of his subordinate officers and soldiers, he himself became emperor, namely ”Emperor Taizong of Tang”.
He also changed the era name to “Zhenguan”.

sentences.simplified: 这就是历史上有名的“玄武门之变”。
sentences.traditional: 這就是歷史上有名的“玄武門之變”。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì lì shǐ shang yǒu míng de xuán wǔ mén zhī biàn

sentences.simplified: 从情理上说，唐太宗李世民亲手杀死了自己的亲兄弟，
sentences.traditional: 從情理上說，唐太宗李世民親手殺死了自己的親兄弟，
sentences.pinyin: cóng qíng lǐ shang shuō táng tài zōng lǐ shì mín qīn shǒu shā sǐ le zì jǐ de qīn xiōng dì
sentences.english: This is the “Xuanwu Gate Incident” that is well-known in history.

sentences.simplified: 又逼迫父亲退位，当然是非常不光彩的。
sentences.traditional: 又逼迫父親退位，當然是非常不光彩的。
sentences.pinyin: yòu bī pò fù qīn tuì wèi dāng rán shì fēi cháng bù guāng cǎi de
sentences.english: From the perspective of reason, Emperor Taizong of Tang Li Shimin personally killing his own brothers, ..

sentences.simplified: 但是站在更广阔的角度观察，他的确是一个英明的君主，值得赞扬的好皇帝。
sentences.traditional: 但是站在更廣闊的角度觀察，他的確是一個英明的君主，值得讚揚的好皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhàn zài gèng guǎng kuò de jiǎo dù guān chá tā dí què shì yí ge yīng míng de jūn zhǔ zhí de zàn yáng de hǎo huáng dì
sentences.english: .. and forcing his father to abdicate were certainly not glorious acts.
But looking from a broader perspective, he certainly was a brilliant monarch, and a good emperor deserving of praise.

sentences.simplified: 李世民上台后，颁布了许多减轻老百姓负担的政策法令。
sentences.traditional: 李世民上台後，頒布了許多減輕老百姓負擔的政策法令。
sentences.pinyin: lǐ shì mín shàng tái hòu bān bù le xǔ duō jiǎn qīng lǎo bǎi xìng fù dān de zhèng cè fǎ lìng

sentences.simplified: 因为他亲身经历过隋朝末年的痛苦历史，深知老百姓的重要，
sentences.traditional: 因為他親身經歷過隋朝末年的痛苦歷史，深知老百姓的重要，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā qīn shēn jīng lì guò suí cháo mò nián de tòng kǔ lì shǐ shēn zhī lǎo bǎi xìng de zhòng yào
sentences.english: After Li Shimin rose to power, he issued many policies and decrees that lightened the burden on ordinary people.

sentences.simplified: 所以他时常提醒自己和儿子们：
sentences.traditional: 所以他時常提醒自己和兒子們：
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā shí cháng tí xǐng zì jǐ hé ér zi men
sentences.english: Because he personally experienced the painful history of the final years of the Sui dynasty, he knew well importance of ordinary people.

sentences.simplified: “民，水也；君，舟也。水能载舟，亦能覆舟。”
sentences.traditional: “民，水也；君，舟也。水能載舟，亦能覆舟。”
sentences.pinyin: mín shuǐ yě jūn zhōu yě shuǐ néng zài zhōu yì néng fù zhōu
sentences.english: So he frequently reminded himself and his sons:

sentences.simplified: 意思是说：皇帝是船，老百姓是水。
sentences.traditional: 意思是說：皇帝是船，老百姓是水。
sentences.pinyin: yì si shì shuō huáng dì shì chuán lǎo bǎi xìng shì shuǐ
sentences.english: “The people are the water; the monarch is a boat. Water can carry a boat; it also can also overturn it.”

sentences.simplified: 水能载起船，也能把船打翻。
sentences.traditional: 水能載起船，也能把船打翻。
sentences.pinyin: shuǐ néng zài qǐ chuán yě néng bǎ chuán dǎ fān
sentences.english: The meaning is: the emperor is a boat, and ordinary people are water.
Water can carry a boat, but it can also overturn it.

sentences.simplified: 正因为唐太宗李世民的爱民亲民、知人善用，
sentences.traditional: 正因為唐太宗李世民的愛民親民、知人善用，
sentences.pinyin: zhèng yīn wèi táng tài zōng lǐ shì mín de ài mín qīn mín zhī rén shàn yòng

sentences.simplified: 他在位期间，国家经济发展、社会安定、政治清明、人民安康，
sentences.traditional: 他在位期間，國家經濟發展、社會安定、政治清明、人民安康，
sentences.pinyin: tā zài wèi qī jiān guó jiā jīng jì fā zhǎn shè huì ān dìng zhèng zhì qīng míng rén mín ān kāng
sentences.english: Precisely because the Emperor Taizong of Tang Li Shimin loved the people, and knew how to judge people and make good use of them ..

sentences.simplified: 唐朝出现了空前的繁荣。
sentences.traditional: 唐朝出現了空前的繁榮。
sentences.pinyin: táng cháo chū xiàn le kōng qián de fán róng
sentences.english: .. during his reign, the country had economic development, social stability, political order, and well-being of the people.

sentences.simplified: 因为其年号为“贞观”，
sentences.traditional: 因為其年號為“貞觀”，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi qí nián hào wéi zhēn guàn
sentences.english: The Tang dynasty gave rise to unprecedented prosperity.

sentences.simplified: 所以人们将其在位期间的清明政治称为“贞观之治”。
sentences.traditional: 所以人們將其在位期間的清明政治稱為“貞觀之治”。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ rén men jiāng qí zài wèi qī jiān de qīng míng zhèng zhì chēng wéi zhēn guàn zhī zhì
sentences.english: Because the era name was “Zhenguan”, ..
.. people called the period of political order during his reign the “Zhenguan Administration”.

raw.synopsis: Li Shimin’s rise to the throne was not easy.
sentence_translations: China’s Most Famous Emperor: Li Shimin
If you were to ask which Chinese dynasty Chinese people reminisce about the most ..
.. many Chinese people would answer: the Tang dynasty.
If you were to ask which emperor of the Tang dynasty Chinese people like the most ..
many Chinese people would answer: Emperor Taizong of Tang, Li Shimin.
In Chinese history, the Tang dynasty was one of the dynasties that was unified for the longest time ..
.. and had the greatest national strength and power.
The strength and power of the Tang dynasty was very closely related to Emperor Taizong of Tang, Li Shimin.
Li Shimin is one of China’s most well-known emperors.
Up until today, there are still many books and television series that enthusiastically discuss his legendary life.
When talking about Li Shimin, we must first start from the bloody scene of a palace coup.
Li Shimin’s father Li Yuan had three sons: the eldest son Li Jiancheng, the second son Li Shimin, and the third son Li Yuanjie.
Li Shimin always followed his father into battles, helping him to overthrow the Sui dynasty, establishing the Tang dynasty.
After the Tang dynasty had been established, Li Yuan served as the emperor.
He didn’t choose the crown price according to the degree of his contribution, nor the level of his competence.
Rather, according to convention, he appointed his eldest son Li Jiancheng to be the crown prince.
This evoked in Li Shimin and his subordinate officers and soldiers a sense of dissatisfaction.
They felt that they had always fought on all four quarters with Li Yuan to create this realm.
It should be Li Shimin, who contributed the most, who served as crown prince.
And the eldest son Li Jiancheng also knew that Li Shimin’s contribution was the greatest, so he was very uneasy.
He was afraid that Li Shimin would steal away his position as crown prince.
As a result, he allied with the third son Li Yuanjie to together push aside Li Shimin.
The contradiction between both parties grew larger and larger.
Just at this time, the northern Turkic people invaded.
In the past, it had always been Li Shimin who lead soldiers into battle.
But this time, Li Jiancheng and Li Yuanjie agreed that they could no longer allow Li Shimin to lead soldiers into battle.
They wanted to take advantage of the current opportunity to make their own contribution, ..
.. seize Li Shimin’s military power, and then kill him.
Unexpectedly, this news was leaked. After Li Shimin found out, he became very indignant.
He scrambled to make the first move, leading people to lie in wait beside the Xuanwu Gate of the imperial palace, ..
.. to first take the action and kill Li Jiancheng and Li Yuanjie.
After the deed was done, Li Shimin reported to his father Li Yuan:
“Jiancheng and Yuanjie wanted to rebel, so they were killed by me.”
After Li Yuan heard this, he was very shocked. Even though he knew that the affair was perhaps not like this, ..
.. this was the current situation, and also Li Shimin held military power.
There was nothing to say, and he could only give in and tacitly agree, appointing Li Shimin as crown prince.
Before long, Li Shimin also forced his father Li Yuan to abdicate.
With the support of his subordinate officers and soldiers, he himself became emperor, namely ”Emperor Taizong of Tang”.
He also changed the era name to “Zhenguan”.
This is the “Xuanwu Gate Incident” that is well-known in history.
From the perspective of reason, Emperor Taizong of Tang Li Shimin personally killing his own brothers, ..
.. and forcing his father to abdicate were certainly not glorious acts.
But looking from a broader perspective, he certainly was a brilliant monarch, and a good emperor deserving of praise.
After Li Shimin rose to power, he issued many policies and decrees that lightened the burden on ordinary people.
Because he personally experienced the painful history of the final years of the Sui dynasty, he knew well importance of ordinary people.
So he frequently reminded himself and his sons:
“The people are the water; the monarch is a boat. Water can carry a boat; it also can also overturn it.”
The meaning is: the emperor is a boat, and ordinary people are water.
Water can carry a boat, but it can also overturn it.
Precisely because the Emperor Taizong of Tang Li Shimin loved the people, and knew how to judge people and make good use of them ..
.. during his reign, the country had economic development, social stability, political order, and well-being of the people.
The Tang dynasty gave rise to unprecedented prosperity.
Because the era name was “Zhenguan”, ..
.. people called the period of political order during his reign the “Zhenguan Administration”.
